code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    sixes = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 6]
    drawn = []
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2, c2 in ones[i+1:]:
            dr, dc = r2-r1, c2-c1
            if abs(dr) == abs(dc) and dr != 0:
                sr = 1 if dr > 0 else -1
                sc = 1 if dc > 0 else -1
                for k in range(abs(dr)+1):
                    r, c = r1+sr*k, c1+sc*k
                    out[r][c] = 1
                drawn.append((r1,c1,r2,c2))
    for r1,c1,r2,c2 in drawn:
        dr, dc = r2-r1, c2-c1
        # Marker 6s on the 1-segment spawn a full perpendicular diagonal.
        for r,c in sixes:
            if (r-r1)*(c2-c1) == (c-c1)*(r2-r1) and min(r1,r2) <= r <= max(r1,r2) and min(c1,c2) <= c <= max(c1,c2):
                if dr == dc:
                    # r+c remains constant
                    for rr in range(h):
                        cc = r+c-rr
                        if 0 <= cc < w: out[rr][cc] = 6
                else:
                    # c-r remains constant
                    for rr in range(h):
                        cc = c-r+rr
                        if 0 <= cc < w: out[rr][cc] = 6
    return out
'''
